title: Healthcare WordPress sitemap and appointment request flow prototype
what: Generates a WordPress page tree and XML sitemap for services, doctor profiles and appointments, plus a responsive sample page with a validated appointment request form.
shows: Patient-friendly navigation structure, doctor-to-service mapping, appointment validation and double-booking protection, verified by tests and a headless browser.
checks: every parent page exists and XML matches tree
double booking rejected and invalid input rejected
done: Page tree for services, doctors, appointments
Responsive sample page with request form
remaining: Custom block theme and post types
limits: Synthetic doctors and services; static prototype, not yet a WordPress theme; no real email delivery or persistent storage.
